title: Docs Lighthouse
description: Serves the built docs the way Cloudflare Pages does and runs Lighthouse on every prerendered route with Lighthouse's default mobile profile, in Playwright's Chromium. Any category under the minimum score fails it (ADR-0016).

dir.description: The built site, relative to the workspace root.

minScore.description: Lowest passing score, 0 to 100, in every category.

outputDir.description: Where the HTML reports go, relative to the workspace root.

runs.description: Runs per route; the run with the median performance score counts, as in Lighthouse CI.

routes.description: Routes to audit; every prerendered route by default.

shard.description: Audit one shard of the routes, such as `2/3`, so parallel runners share them; routes are dealt out in turn.

cpuSlowdownMultiplier.description: CPU slowdown to use instead of calibrating it to the host's benchmark (ADR-0016, amendment 8).

performanceFloor.description: Lowest passing performance score; scores from here up to minScore warn. 0, the default, never fails on performance (ADR-0016, amendment 14).
